name: The Stockade Riots
summary: At Stormwind's prison gates, Warden Thelwater sends you into the Stockade Riots to prove your loyalty to the city guards. The uprising has seized the prison, and he orders you to find and execute its ringleader, Bazil Thredd.

sections.title: Blood on the Stone
sections.body: Deep beneath the Mage Quarter's cobblestones, the Stockade has fallen into lawlessness. Criminals, Defias insurgents, and violent cutthroats have broken containment and seized the cell blocks, making the prison an impenetrable war zone. Warden Thelwater and his guards cling desperately to the entrance, unable to push inside and restore order by ordinary means.

sections.title: The Price of Trust
sections.body: Warden Thelwater distrusts anyone asking after Bazil Thredd, so he demands proof of your allegiance. He orders you through the riot-torn cell blocks to slay Thredd in his cell and return with the rebel leader's severed head. Only by killing the uprising's figurehead can an outsider show they are not secretly allied with the rebellion.

sections.title: A Severed Thread
sections.body: Bazil Thredd leads the riot, and his death deals the uprising's organization a decisive blow. It also silences any direct answers he might have given about the conspiracy gripping Stormwind. When Warden Thelwater sees Thredd's head, he is surprised and admits the prison may become manageable again. He also offers clues about Thredd's secret contacts before the insurrection.

faq.q: Who gives the quest The Stockade Riots?
faq.answer: Warden Thelwater gives it just inside the Stockade's entrance tunnel in Stormwind's Mage Quarter.

faq.q: What do I need to do to complete the quest?
faq.answer: You must enter the prison dungeon, find ringleader Bazil Thredd in the eastern cell block, kill him, and return his severed head to Warden Thelwater.

faq.q: Where is Bazil Thredd located inside the Stockade?
faq.answer: From the entrance, follow the northern corridor to the T-intersection, then take the eastern cell block. Bazil Thredd is in the center cell of a three-room chamber guarded by the ogre Hamhock.

faq.q: Why does Warden Thelwater want Bazil Thredd dead?
faq.answer: Bazil Thredd is the uprising's primary ringleader. Warden Thelwater believes killing him is the only way for the guards to regain control of the rioting cell blocks, and it also tests whether you are secretly working with the rebels.

faq.q: What happens after completing The Stockade Riots?
faq.answer: After you bring back Thredd's head, Warden Thelwater sends you to investigate a mysterious figure who visited the prison before the riot. The next stage is called The Curious Visitor.

faq.q: Can Horde players obtain this quest?
faq.answer: No. The Stockade is a dungeon deep inside Stormwind, the Alliance capital, so Horde players cannot obtain this.

angles.text: A full-scale revolt beneath the Mage Quarter threatens Stormwind's stability while the King remains missing and the kingdom is stretched thin.
Many rioters are Defias operatives and disgruntled stonemasons who turned against their kingdom after the reconstruction dispute.
Infiltrating the riot shows how far the Defias Brotherhood's clandestine underground network can go when it loses all restraint.
